simple.meaning: חֹבֵל (chôbêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “a sailor.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֹבֵל (H2259) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 27:8, with occurrences in Ezekiel, Jonah.

definitions.full: H2259. chobel חֹבֵל noun masculine sailor (denominative from חֶבֶל ; i.e. rope -puller) — הַיָּם חֹבְלֵי Ezek 27:29 ; חֹבְלָ֑יִךְ 27:8 , 27 , 28 ; collective הַחֹבֵל רַב i.e. the captain Jonah 1:6 .
definitions.rootNote: active participle from 2254 (in the sense of handling ropes);
